body:
Pass 42. Epic 9 claimed, so I checked all eight criteria against the tree and put the result in one note on the epic.

Met and verified: print/format/coercion (26 S3 methods, as_neurovol round-trips exactly), README now opens with the fMRI problem, the package-free contract files are gone with the independent oracle helpers intact, suite green at 1819.

New gap, bd-01KZY2DW2XHE207JMFPVEV957W: "runnable Rd examples cover the first user journey" is not met. 5 of 82 Rd files have examples and they are the Epic 5-7 metric/plan family. The first journey - relation, compile_frame, searchlights, geometry, contrast, rdm, rsa, lm_relation_fit, as_neurovol - has none. Small job, since the README already has a runnable sequence for exactly those.

Remaining: scale gates never run, R CMD check stale, artifact has no commit, gate fixture statistically degenerate, MC variance gate at 1% headroom.

One ordering point worth planning: add the Rd examples BEFORE running R CMD check, since examples are executed by it. Otherwise you certify a check and then enlarge its surface.
